title: Mythic skills on an NPC
description: A Skeleton King NPC running its Mythic timer, click and damage skills

files.MythicMobs/Mobs/animus.yml:
AnimusMeg:
  Type: ZOMBIE
  Display: 'Knight'
  Skills:
  - model{mid=knight} @self ~onSpawn
  - message{m="<caster.name> greets <trigger.name>"} @trigger ~onInteract
AnimusKing:
  Type: SKELETON
  Display: 'Skeleton King'
  Equipment:
  - GOLDEN_HELMET:4
  - BOW HAND
  Options:
    Glowing: true
  Skills:
  - message{m="The Skeleton King nods at <trigger.name>"} @trigger ~onInteract
  - message{m="<trigger.name> struck the Skeleton King"} @trigger ~onDamaged
  - message{m="The Skeleton King watches the field"} @PlayersInRadius{r=24} ~onTimer:160

console: animus mythic king AnimusKing world=world x=0.5 y=61 z=5.5 folder=live

beats.result: the glowing Skeleton King with its golden helmet and bow
The Skeleton King nods at the player
the player struck the Skeleton King
the timer skill line: The Skeleton King watches the field

closing: The Skeleton King NPC runs its Mythic click, damage and timer skills
